Just landed at Kansai Airport? Here's the train we'd take ✈️🚆

🏨 Staying in Namba → Nankai Airport Express, 43 min, about ¥970
🧳 Big bags → Nankai Rapi:t, 34–39 min, reserved seat
🏙️ Osaka Station, Tennoji or Shin-Osaka → JR Haruka, no change
🚌 Landing at Terminal 2? Shuttle bus to Terminal 1 first

Comment AIRPORT and we'll DM you the full guide with every time and fare.

First time in Osaka? Here's where we'd stay, and why 🏮

📍 Namba: Dotonbori is 3–5 min on foot, and the airport train stops here
🚆 Umeda: Kyoto in 29 min, Universal Studios about 15
🧸 Tennoji: calmer, the zoo is a short walk, 30 min from the airport

All three sit on one subway line, under 15 min apart.

Staying in Namba? Here's what we'd walk to first 🏮

🌃 Dotonbori: 3–5 min from Exit 14, best after dark
🍣 Kuromon Market: about 8 min, around 150 food stalls, go before noon
☔ Shinsaibashi-suji: a 600 m covered arcade starting at the canal
⛩️ Hozenji Yokocho: a quiet stone alley, 3–5 min away

All of it under 15 minutes on foot, no train needed.

Four friends in Osaka: one apartment or two hotel rooms? 🏠🏨

🛏️ 2–3 nights: two twin rooms near the station. Two bathrooms, daily cleaning
🏢 4+ nights: an apartment hotel often wins. Beds for four, a washer, staff on hand
🔎 Private apartment? Check the listing shows a registration number
📍 Where: Namba, easy to split up by day and meet for dinner

Not sleeping early in Osaka? Read this before you book 🌙

🚇 Most subway lines stop around midnight
🏮 Namba: Dotonbori is 3–5 min on foot
🍻 Ura-Namba: standing bars and small izakaya, mostly locals
🌃 North side? Stay near JR Tenma and walk home from Ura-Tenma

Pick your hotel by where you'll be at 1am, not at noon.

Kuromon too crowded? Here's where Osaka actually shops 🐟

🍣 Kizu Market: a chefs' wholesale market, 1 subway stop from Namba. Go 8:30–10:30, closed Sundays
🥩 Tsuruhashi: yakiniku, kimchi and Korean food right outside the station
🛍️ Tenjinbashisuji: about 2.6 km of covered shops locals use every day

Many small stalls prefer cash, so bring some yen.

Want local Osaka, not the neon? Here's where we'd stay 🏮

🛍️ Tenma: Japan's longest shopping street, about 2.6 km under one roof
🍶 Ura-Tenma: tiny izakaya full of office workers, ≈5 min from JR Tenma
🚃 Still central: Osaka Station is 1 stop on the Loop Line
🥩 Tsuruhashi: yakiniku heaven, direct trains to Namba and Nara

First trip with 2–3 nights? Stay central. Second trip or 4+ nights? Go local.

Can ¥5,000 a night buy you privacy in Namba? We checked real prices for the same nights 🏨

🛏️ Wednesday: a single with its own bathroom, ~600 m from Namba Station, about ¥5,000
🧳 Capsule nearby the same night: about ¥3,200
📈 Saturday: the cheapest private room within 1 km was over ¥11,000, so ¥5,000 only bought a capsule

Our pick: book Namba Sunday to Thursday, or take the capsule on Saturday.
